# Congressman Jesús “Chuy” García’s Statement on Trump Elevating Stephen Miller to Chief of Staff

November 6, 2026

Press Release

CHICAGO — Congressman Jesús “Chuy” García issued the following statement: 

“Tuesday night, Latinos and millions of Americans throughout the country voted to reject Trump’s vision for America, one driven by Stephen Miller. [...] “Trump is showing us exactly who he is by elevating this white supremacist to Chief of Staff. The American people reject his hateful vision, and Democrats will hold him and every other criminal in the Trump Administration accountable.”

###

[Source 2 — www.nytimes.com (Bias: Lean Left)] (URL: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/06/us/politics/susie-wiles-chief-of-staff-trump.html):

In Elevating Stephen Miller, Trump Doubles Down on Hard-Line Agenda

The new White House chief of staff is responsible for some of the most provocative policies of President Trump’s second term, as well as an aggressive approach to executive power.

Actual Article Body:
President Trump announced Friday he would make Stephen Miller, the powerful domestic policy adviser who has helped drive the administration’s immigration crackdown, his new chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles following sweeping Republican losses in the midterm elections.

Ms. Wiles is moving to the president’s political operation, Mr. Trump said. But her departure and the ascent of Mr. Miller will fundamentally shift the circle of advisers around Mr. Trump as the White House absorbs the shock of the midterm elections.

It also signals an aggressive doubling-down by the president, after losses of Republican majorities in the House and Senate that served as a rebuke of Mr. Trump’s handling of issues ranging from the economy to the war with Iran to tariffs to his push for a mid-decade redistricting effort.
